The Item's bank accounts that have the selected data.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|string|false|none|Plaid's unique identifier for the account. This value will not change unless Plaid can't reconcile the account with the data returned by the financial institution. This may occur, for example, when the name of the account changes. If this happens a new `account_id` will be assigned to the account.<br><br>If an account with a specific `account_id` disappears instead of changing, the account is likely closed. Closed accounts are not returned by the Plaid API.<br><br>Like all Plaid identifiers, the `account_id` is case sensitive.|
|mask|string \| null|true|none|The last 2-4 alphanumeric characters of an account's official account number.<br>Note that the mask may be non-unique between an Item's accounts, and it may also not match the mask that the bank displays to the user.|
|metadata|[CraBankIncomeAccountMetadata](#schemacrabankincomeaccountmetadata)|true|none|An object containing metadata about the extracted account.|
|name|string|true|none|The name of the bank account.|
|official_name|string \| null|true|none|The official name of the bank account.|
|subtype|[DepositoryAccountSubtype](#schemadepositoryaccountsubtype)|true|none|Valid account subtypes for depository accounts. For a list containing descriptions of each subtype, see [Account schemas](https://plaid.com/docs/api/accounts/#StandaloneAccountType-depository).|
|type|[CreditBankIncomeAccountType](#schemacreditbankincomeaccounttype)|true|none|The account type. This will always be `depository`.|
|owners|[[Owner](#schemaowner)]|true|none|Data returned by the financial institution about the account owner or owners. Identity information is optional, so field may return an empty array.|

Detailed information for the income source.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|string|false|none|The account ID with which this income source is associated.|
|income_source_id|string|false|none|A unique identifier for an income source. If the report is regenerated and a new `report_id` is created, the new report will have a new set of `income_source_id`s.|
|income_description|string|false|none|The most common name or original description for the underlying income transactions.|
|income_category|[CreditBankIncomeCategory](#schemacreditbankincomecategory)|false|none|The income category.<br><br>`BANK_INTEREST`: Interest earned from a bank account.<br><br>`BENEFIT_OTHER`: Government benefits other than retirement, unemployment, child support, or disability. Currently used only in the UK, to represent benefits such as Cost of Living Payments.<br><br>`CASH`: Deprecated and used only for existing legacy implementations. Has been replaced by `CASH_DEPOSIT` and `TRANSFER_FROM_APPLICATION`.<br><br>`CASH_DEPOSIT`: A cash or check deposit.<br><br>`CHILD_SUPPORT`: Child support payments received.<br><br>`GIG_ECONOMY`: Income earned as a gig economy worker, e.g. driving for Uber, Lyft, Postmates, DoorDash, etc.<br><br>`LONG_TERM_DISABILITY`: Disability payments, including Social Security disability benefits.<br><br>`OTHER`: Income that could not be categorized as any other income category.<br><br>`MILITARY`: Veterans benefits. Income earned as salary for serving in the military (e.g. through DFAS) will be classified as `SALARY` rather than `MILITARY`.<br><br>`RENTAL`: Income earned from a rental property. Income may be identified as rental when the payment is received through a rental platform, e.g. Airbnb; rent paid directly by the tenant to the property owner (e.g. via cash, check, or ACH) will typically not be classified as rental income.<br><br>`RETIREMENT`: Payments from private retirement systems, pensions, and government retirement programs, including Social Security retirement benefits.<br><br>`SALARY`: Payment from an employer to an earner or other form of permanent employment.<br><br>`TAX_REFUND`: A tax refund.<br><br>`TRANSFER_FROM_APPLICATION`: Deposits from a money transfer app, such as Venmo, Cash App, or Zelle.<br><br>`UNEMPLOYMENT`: Unemployment benefits. In the UK, includes certain low-income benefits such as the Universal Credit.|
|start_date|string(date)|false|none|Minimum of all dates within the specific income sources in the user's bank account for days requested by the client.<br>The date will be returned in an ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).|
|end_date|string(date)|false|none|Maximum of all dates within the specific income sources in the user's bank account for days requested by the client.<br>The date will be returned in an ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).|
|pay_frequency|[CreditBankIncomePayFrequency](#schemacreditbankincomepayfrequency)|false|none|The income pay frequency.|
|total_amount|number|false|none|Total amount of earnings in the user's bank account for the specific income source for days requested by the client.|
|iso_currency_code|[CreditIsoCurrencyCode](#schemacreditisocurrencycode)|false|none|The ISO 4217 currency code of the amount or balance.|
|unofficial_currency_code|[CreditUnofficialCurrencyCode](#schemacreditunofficialcurrencycode)|false|none|The unofficial currency code associated with the amount or balance. Always `null` if `iso_currency_code` is non-null.<br>Unofficial currency codes are used for currencies that do not have official ISO currency codes, such as cryptocurrencies and the currencies of certain countries.|
|transaction_count|integer|false|none|Number of transactions for the income source within the start and end date.|
|next_payment_date|string(date) \| null|false|none|The expected date of the end user's next paycheck for the income source.<br>The date will be returned in an ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).|
|status|[CraBankIncomeStatus](#schemacrabankincomestatus)|false|none|The status of the income sources.<br><br>`ACTIVE`: The income source is active.<br><br>`INACTIVE`: The income source is inactive.<br><br>`UNKNOWN`: The income source status is unknown.|
|historical_average_monthly_gross_income|number \| null|false|none|An estimate of the average gross monthly income based on the historical net amount and income category for the income source(s).|
|historical_average_monthly_income|number \| null|false|none|The average monthly net income amount estimated based on the historical data for the income source(s).|
|forecasted_average_monthly_income|number \| null|false|none|The predicted average monthly net income amount for the income source(s).|
|forecasted_average_monthly_income_prediction_intervals|[[CraPredictionInterval](#schemacrapredictioninterval)]|true|none|The prediction interval(s) for the forecasted average monthly income.|
|employer|[CraBankIncomeEmployer](#schemacrabankincomeemployer)|false|none|The object containing employer data.|
|income_provider|[CraBankIncomeIncomeProvider](#schemacrabankincomeincomeprovider)|true|none|The object containing data about the income provider.|
|historical_summary|[[CraBankIncomeHistoricalSummary](#schemacrabankincomehistoricalsummary)]|false|none|none|

|start_date|string(date)|false|none|The earliest date within the days requested in which all income sources identified by Plaid appear in a user's account.<br>The date will be returned in an ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).|
|end_date|string(date)|false|none|The latest date in which all income sources identified by Plaid appear in the user's account.<br>The date will be returned in an ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).|
|income_sources_count|integer|false|none|Number of income sources per end user.|
|income_categories_count|integer|false|none|Number of income categories per end user.|
|income_transactions_count|integer|false|none|Number of income transactions per end user.|
|historical_average_monthly_gross_income|[[CreditAmountWithCurrency](#schemacreditamountwithcurrency)]|false|none|An estimate of the average gross monthly income based on the historical net amount and income category for the income source(s). The average monthly income is calculated based on the lifetime of the income stream, rather than the entire historical period included in the scope of the report.|
|historical_average_monthly_income|[[CreditAmountWithCurrency](#schemacreditamountwithcurrency)]|false|none|The average monthly income amount estimated based on the historical data for the income source(s). The average monthly income is calculated based on the lifetime of the income stream, rather than the entire historical period included in the scope of the report.|
|forecasted_average_monthly_income|[[CreditAmountWithCurrency](#schemacreditamountwithcurrency)]|false|none|The predicted average monthly income amount for the income source(s).|
|historical_annual_gross_income|[[CreditAmountWithCurrency](#schemacreditamountwithcurrency)]|false|none|An estimate of the annual gross income for the income source, calculated by multiplying the `historical_average_monthly_gross_income` by 12.|
|historical_annual_income|[[CreditAmountWithCurrency](#schemacreditamountwithcurrency)]|false|none|An estimate of the annual net income for the income source, calculated by multiplying the `historical_average_monthly_income` by 12.|
|forecasted_annual_income|[[CreditAmountWithCurrency](#schemacreditamountwithcurrency)]|false|none|The predicted average annual income amount for the income source(s).|
|historical_summary|[[CraBankIncomeHistoricalSummary](#schemacrabankincomehistoricalsummary)]|false|none|none|

|transaction_id|string|true|none|The unique ID of the transaction. Like all Plaid identifiers, the `transaction_id` is case sensitive.|

|pending|boolean|true|none|When true, identifies the transaction as pending or unsettled.<br>Pending transaction details (name, type, amount, category ID) may change before they are settled.|
|check_number|string \| null|false|none|The check number of the transaction. This field is only populated for check transactions.|

|unofficial_currency_code|[CreditUnofficialCurrencyCode](#schemacreditunofficialcurrencycode)|true|none|The unofficial currency code associated with the amount or balance. Always `null` if `iso_currency_code` is non-null.<br>Unofficial currency codes are used for currencies that do not have official ISO currency codes, such as cryptocurrencies and the currencies of certain countries.|

### Properties

|error_code|string|true|none|We use standard HTTP response codes for success and failure notifications, and our errors are further classified by `error_type`. In general, 200 HTTP codes correspond to success, 40X codes are for developer- or user-related failures, and 50X codes are for Plaid-related issues. Error fields will be `null` if no error has occurred.|
|error_message|string|true|none|A developer-friendly representation of the error code. This may change over time and is not safe for programmatic use.|
|display_message|string|true|none|A user-friendly representation of the error code. null if the error is not related to user action.<br>This may change over time and is not safe for programmatic use.|

CraCheckReportCreateRequest defines the request schema for `/cra/check_report/create`.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|client_id|[APIClientID](#schemaapiclientid)|false|none|Your Plaid API `client_id`. The `client_id` is required and may be provided either in the `PLAID-CLIENT-ID` header or as part of a request body.|
|secret|[APISecret](#schemaapisecret)|false|none|Your Plaid API `secret`. The `secret` is required and may be provided either in the `PLAID-SECRET` header or as part of a request body.|
|user_id|[NewUserID](#schemanewuserid)|false|none|A unique user identifier, created by `/user/create`. Integrations that began using `/user/create` after December 10, 2025 use this field to identify a user instead of the `user_token`. For more details, see [New User APIs](https://plaid.com/docs/api/users/user-apis).|
|user_token|[UserToken](#schemausertoken)|false|none|The user token associated with the user for which data is being requested. This field is used only by customers with pre-existing integrations that already use the `user_token` field. All other customers should use the `user_id` instead. For more details, see [New User APIs](https://plaid.com/docs/api/users/user-apis).|
|webhook|string(url)|true|none|The destination URL to which webhooks will be sent<br>|
|days_requested|integer|true|none|The number of days of data to request for the report. Maximum is 731; minimum is 180. If a value lower than 180 is provided, a minimum of 180 days of history will be requested.|
|days_required|integer|false|none|The minimum number of days of data required for the report to be successfully generated.|
|client_report_id|string \| null|false|none|Client-generated identifier, which can be used by lenders to track loan applications.|
|products|[[Products](#schemaproducts)]|false|none|Specifies a list of products to generate when creating the report (in addition to the Base Report, which is always generated except for requests for only `cra_network_insights` or for FICO-only Partner Insights). These products will be made available before a success webhook is sent. Note that specifying `cra_partner_insights` in this field will trigger a billable event. Other products are not billed until the respective reports are retrieved via their product-specific `/get` endpoints.|
|base_report|[CraCheckReportCreateBaseReportOptions](#schemacracheckreportcreatebasereportoptions)|false|none|Defines configuration options to generate a Base Report|
|cashflow_insights|[CraCheckReportCreateCashflowInsightsOptions](#schemacracheckreportcreatecashflowinsightsoptions)|false|none|Defines configuration options to generate Cashflow Insights|
|partner_insights|[CraCheckReportCreatePartnerInsightsOptions](#schemacracheckreportcreatepartnerinsightsoptions)|false|none|Defines configuration to generate Partner Insights.|
|lend_score|[CraCheckReportCreateLendScoreOptions](#schemacracheckreportcreatelendscoreoptions)|false|none|Defines configuration options to generate the LendScore|
|network_insights|[CraCheckReportCreateNetworkInsightsOptions](#schemacracheckreportcreatenetworkinsightsoptions)|false|none|Defines configuration options to generate Network Insights|
|include_investments|boolean \| null|false|none|Indicates that investment data should be extracted from the linked account(s).|
|income_insights|[CraCheckReportCreateIncomeInsightsOptions](#schemacracheckreportcreateincomeinsightsoptions)|false|none|Defines configuration options to generate Income Insights.|
|consumer_report_permissible_purpose|[ConsumerReportPermissiblePurpose](#schemaconsumerreportpermissiblepurpose)|true|none|Describes the reason you are generating a Consumer Report for this user. When calling `/link/token/create`, this field is required when using Plaid Check (CRA) products; invalid if not using Plaid Check (CRA) products.<br><br>`ACCOUNT_REVIEW_CREDIT`: In connection with a consumer credit transaction for the review or collection of an account pursuant to FCRA Section 604(a)(3)(A).<br><br>`ACCOUNT_REVIEW_NON_CREDIT`: For a legitimate business need of the information to review a non-credit account provided primarily for personal, family, or household purposes to determine whether the consumer continues to meet the terms of the account pursuant to FCRA Section 604(a)(3)(F)(2).<br><br>`EXTENSION_OF_CREDIT`: In connection with a credit transaction initiated by and involving the consumer pursuant to FCRA Section 604(a)(3)(A).<br><br>`LEGITIMATE_BUSINESS_NEED_TENANT_SCREENING`: For a legitimate business need in connection with a business transaction initiated by the consumer primarily for personal, family, or household purposes in connection with a property rental assessment pursuant to FCRA Section 604(a)(3)(F)(i).<br><br>`LEGITIMATE_BUSINESS_NEED_OTHER`: For a legitimate business need in connection with a business transaction made primarily for personal, family, or household initiated by the consumer pursuant to FCRA Section 604(a)(3)(F)(i).<br><br>`WRITTEN_INSTRUCTION_PREQUALIFICATION`: In accordance with the written instructions of the consumer pursuant to FCRA Section 604(a)(2), to evaluate an application's profile to make an offer to the consumer.<br><br>`WRITTEN_INSTRUCTION_OTHER`: In accordance with the written instructions of the consumer pursuant to FCRA Section 604(a)(2), such as when an individual agrees to act as a guarantor or assumes personal liability for a consumer, business, or commercial loan.<br><br>`ELIGIBILITY_FOR_GOVT_BENEFITS`:  In connection with an eligibility determination for a government benefit where the entity is required to consider an applicant's financial status pursuant to FCRA Section 604(a)(3)(D).|

Report characteristics returned by FICO describing the banking data used to generate the UltraFICO® score.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|num_accounts|integer \| null|false|none|Total number of accounts included in the report. Limited to checking, savings, and money market accounts.|
|avg_daily_balance_over_1_month|number(double) \| null|false|none|Average daily balance over the past 1 month.|
|avg_daily_balance_over_3_months|number(double) \| null|false|none|Average daily balance over the past 3 months.|
|avg_daily_balance_over_6_months|number(double) \| null|false|none|Average daily balance over the past 6 months.|
|avg_daily_balance_over_12_months|number(double) \| null|false|none|Average daily balance over the past 12 months.|
|days_since_earliest_tx|integer \| null|false|none|Number of days since the earliest transaction in the report.|
|days_since_most_recent_negative_ending_balance|integer \| null|false|none|Number of days since the most recent day with a negative ending balance.|
|days_since_most_recent_insufficient_funds_fee_debit_tx|integer \| null|false|none|Number of days since the most recent insufficient funds fee debit transaction.|
|tot_number_days_with_negative_balance_over_1_month|integer \| null|false|none|Total number of days with a negative balance over the past 1 month.|
|tot_number_days_with_negative_balance_over_3_months|integer \| null|false|none|Total number of days with a negative balance over the past 3 months.|
|tot_number_days_with_negative_balance_over_6_months|integer \| null|false|none|Total number of days with a negative balance over the past 6 months.|
|tot_number_days_with_negative_balance_over_12_months|integer \| null|false|none|Total number of days with a negative balance over the past 12 months.|
|days_since_most_recent_tx|integer \| null|false|none|Number of days since the most recent transaction.|
|days_with_tx_over_1_month|integer \| null|false|none|Number of days with at least one transaction over the past 1 month.|
|days_with_tx_over_3_months|integer \| null|false|none|Number of days with at least one transaction over the past 3 months.|
|days_with_tx_over_6_months|integer \| null|false|none|Number of days with at least one transaction over the past 6 months.|
|days_with_tx_over_12_months|integer \| null|false|none|Number of days with at least one transaction over the past 12 months.|
|tot_current_balances|number(double) \| null|false|none|Sum of current balances across all accounts in the report.|
|num_checking_accounts|integer \| null|false|none|Number of checking accounts included in the report.|
|num_money_market_accounts|integer \| null|false|none|Number of money market accounts included in the report.|
|num_savings_accounts|integer \| null|false|none|Number of savings accounts included in the report.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|request_correlation_id|string|false|none|Client-generated identifier that can be used to correlate scoring requests with their scoring results.|
|fico_scoring_request_id|string|false|none|FICO-provided identifier that uniquely identifies this score generation request.|

|error_reason|string|false|none|Human-readable description of why the UltraFICO® score could not be computed.|
|exclusion_code|string \| null|false|none|FICO exclusion code indicating why an UltraFICO® score could not be computed due to consumer-data conditions (e.g. insufficient account history). `null` when the exclusion code is not set; "0" when a score was produced.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ultrafico_score_version|[CraPartnerInsightsUltraFicoScoreVersion](#schemacrapartnerinsightsultraficoscoreversion)|true|none|The version of the UltraFICO® score.|
|score|integer|true|none|Numeric value of the UltraFICO® score.|
|negative_reason_codes|[string]|false|none|Negative reason codes associated with the score (reasons the score moved downward), in priority order. May contain up to 4 items.|
|positive_reason_codes|[string]|false|none|Positive reason codes associated with the score (reasons the score moved upward), in priority order. May contain up to 4 items.|
|reason_code_1|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** Deprecated. Use `negative_reason_codes` instead. The first reason code associated with the score.|
|reason_code_2|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** Deprecated. Use `negative_reason_codes` instead. The second reason code associated with the score.|
|reason_code_3|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** Deprecated. Use `negative_reason_codes` instead. The third reason code associated with the score.|
|reason_code_4|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** Deprecated. Use `negative_reason_codes` instead. The fourth reason code associated with the score.|
|positive_reason_code_1|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** Deprecated. Use `positive_reason_codes` instead. The first positive reason code associated with the score.|
|positive_reason_code_2|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** Deprecated. Use `positive_reason_codes` instead. The second positive reason code associated with the score.|
|positive_reason_code_3|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** Deprecated. Use `positive_reason_codes` instead. The third positive reason code associated with the score.|
|positive_reason_code_4|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** Deprecated. Use `positive_reason_codes` instead. The fourth positive reason code associated with the score.|
|did_inquiries_adversely_affect_score|boolean \| null|false|none|Whether inquiries adversely affected the score but were not represented in one of the four reason codes. Sometimes referred to as the FACTA Flag.|

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|ultrafico_score_version|1.0|

Account data corresponding to the Item from which Partner Insights were generated.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|string|false|none|Plaid's unique identifier for the account. This value will not change unless Plaid can't reconcile the account with the data returned by the financial institution. This may occur, for example, when the name of the account changes. If this happens a new `account_id` will be assigned to the account.<br><br>If an account with a specific `account_id` disappears instead of changing, the account is likely closed. Closed accounts are not returned by the Plaid API.<br><br>Like all Plaid identifiers, the `account_id` is case sensitive.|
|mask|string \| null|true|none|The last 2-4 alphanumeric characters of an account's official account number.<br>Note that the mask may be non-unique between an Item's accounts, and it may also not match the mask that the bank displays to the user.|
|metadata|[CraPartnerInsightsItemAccountMetadata](#schemacrapartnerinsightsitemaccountmetadata)|true|none|An object containing metadata about the extracted account.|
|name|string|true|none|The name of the account|
|official_name|string \| null|true|none|The official name of the bank account.|
|subtype|[DepositoryAccountSubtype](#schemadepositoryaccountsubtype)|true|none|Valid account subtypes for depository accounts. For a list containing descriptions of each subtype, see [Account schemas](https://plaid.com/docs/api/accounts/#StandaloneAccountType-depository).|
|type|[CreditBankIncomeAccountType](#schemacreditbankincomeaccounttype)|true|none|The account type. This will always be `depository`.|
|owners|[[Owner](#schemaowner)]|true|none|Data returned by the financial institution about the account owner or owners. Identity information is optional, so field may return an empty array.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|subtype|checking|
|subtype|savings|
|subtype|hsa|
|subtype|cd|
|subtype|money market|
|subtype|paypal|
|subtype|prepaid|
|subtype|cash management|
|subtype|ebt|
|subtype|limited purpose checking|
|subtype|all|
|type|depository|

<h2 id="tocS_IncomeInsightsFilter">IncomeInsightsFilter</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaincomeinsightsfilter"></a>
<a id="schema_IncomeInsightsFilter"></a>
<a id="tocSincomeinsightsfilter"></a>
<a id="tocsincomeinsightsfilter"></a>

```json
{
  "included_categories": [
    "string"
  ],
  "excluded_categories": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

Filters the returned income streams based on the specified income categories. If no filters are requested, streams from the following default set of categories are returned:
- `EARNED_INCOME.*` (`EARNED_INCOME.SALARY`, `EARNED_INCOME.GIG_ECONOMY`, `EARNED_INCOME.SELF_EMPLOYED`)
- `BENEFITS.DISABILITY`
- `RETIREMENT.*` (`RETIREMENT.GOVERNMENT_DERIVED`, `RETIREMENT.PRIVATE_RETIREMENT`, `RETIREMENT.PLAN_DISTRIBUTION`)

The final list of income categories is generated by adding the `included_categories`, then removing the `excluded_categories`. Priority is given to `excluded_categories` in the case of collisions.

Filter patterns supported:
- `*`: All categories
- `PRIMARY.*`: All categories within the specified primary category
- `PRIMARY.SECONDARY`: A specific income category

For a list of income categories, see the [Income V2 Category Taxonomy](https://plaid.com/documents/income-v2-category-taxonomy.csv).

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|included_categories|[string]|true|none|Includes income streams matching the specified categories.|
|excluded_categories|[string]|false|none|Excludes income streams matching the specified categories.|


Contains data for the CRA Home Lending Report.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|report_id|string|true|none|The unique identifier associated with the Home Lending Report object. This ID will be the same as the Base Report ID.|
|gse_reference_id|string|false|none|A unique token that can be shared with GSEs in order to provide them access to the report. This is automatically created during report generation when GSE options are specified.|
|client_report_id|string \| null|false|none|Client-generated identifier, which can be used by lenders to track loan applications.|
|voa|[CraVoaReport](#schemacravoareport)|false|none|An object representing a VOA report.|
|employment_refresh|[CraEmploymentRefreshReport](#schemacraemploymentrefreshreport)|false|none|An object representing an Employment Refresh Report.|
|income|[CraVerificationIncomeReport](#schemacraverificationincomereport)|false|none|An object representing an Income Report within the Home Lending Report.|

Attributes for the VOA report.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|total_inflow_amount|[TotalReportInflowAmount](#schematotalreportinflowamount)|true|none|Total amount of money into the report's accounts in the time period of the report. This field only takes into account USD transactions from the accounts.|
|total_outflow_amount|[TotalReportOutflowAmount](#schematotalreportoutflowamount)|true|none|Total amount of money out of the report's accounts in the time period of the report. This field only takes into account USD transactions from the accounts.|

|official_name|string \| null|true|none|The official name of the account as given by the financial institution.|

In API versions 2018-05-22 and earlier, this type is called `brokerage` instead.<br><br>`credit:` Credit card<br><br>`depository:` Depository account<br><br>`loan:` Loan account<br><br>`other:` Non-specified account type<br><br>See the [Account type schema](https://plaid.com/docs/api/accounts#account-type-schema) for a full listing of account types and corresponding subtypes.|

|owners|[[Owner](#schemaowner)]|true|none|Data returned by the financial institution about the account owner or owners.|
|ownership_type|[OwnershipType](#schemaownershiptype)|true|none|How an asset is owned.<br><br>`association`: Ownership by a corporation, partnership, or unincorporated association, including for-profit and not-for-profit organizations.<br><br>`individual`: Ownership by an individual.<br><br>`joint`: Joint ownership by multiple parties.<br><br>`trust`: Ownership by a revocable or irrevocable trust.|

```json
{
  "available": 0,
  "current": 0,
  "iso_currency_code": "string",
  "unofficial_currency_code": "string",
  "historical_balances": [
    {
      "current": 0,
      "date": "1970-01-01",
      "iso_currency_code": "string",
      "unofficial_currency_code": "string"
    }
  ],
  "average_balance_30_days": 0,
  "average_balance_60_days": 0,
  "nsf_overdraft_transactions_count": 0
}
```

VOA Report information about an account's balances.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|available|number(double) \| null|true|none|The amount of funds available to be withdrawn from the account, as determined by the financial institution.<br><br>For `credit`-type accounts, the `available` balance typically equals the `limit` less the `current` balance, less any pending outflows plus any pending inflows.<br><br>For `depository`-type accounts, the `available` balance typically equals the `current` balance less any pending outflows plus any pending inflows. For `depository`-type accounts, the `available` balance does not include the overdraft limit.<br><br>For `investment`-type accounts (or `brokerage`-type accounts for API versions 2018-05-22 and earlier), the `available` balance is the total cash available to withdraw as presented by the institution.<br><br>Note that not all institutions calculate the `available`  balance. In the event that `available` balance is unavailable, Plaid will return an `available` balance value of `null`.<br><br>Available balance may be cached and is not guaranteed to be up-to-date in real-time unless the value was returned by `/accounts/balance/get`.<br><br>If `current` is `null` this field is guaranteed not to be `null`.|
|current|number(double) \| null|true|none|The total amount of funds in or owed by the account.<br><br>For `credit`-type accounts, a positive balance indicates the amount owed; a negative amount indicates the lender owing the account holder.<br><br>For `loan`-type accounts, the current balance is the principal remaining on the loan, except in the case of student loan accounts at Sallie Mae (`ins_116944`). For Sallie Mae student loans, the account's balance includes both principal and any outstanding interest.<br><br>For `investment`-type accounts (or `brokerage`-type accounts for API versions 2018-05-22 and earlier), the current balance is the total value of assets as presented by the institution.<br><br>Note that balance information may be cached unless the value was returned by `/accounts/balance/get`; if the Item is enabled for Transactions, the balance will be at least as recent as the most recent Transaction update. If you require real-time balance information, use the `available` balance as provided by `/accounts/balance/get`.<br><br>When returned by `/accounts/balance/get`, this field may be `null`. When this happens, `available` is guaranteed not to be `null`.|
|iso_currency_code|string \| null|true|none|The ISO-4217 currency code of the balance. Always null if `unofficial_currency_code` is non-null.|
|unofficial_currency_code|string \| null|true|none|The unofficial currency code associated with the balance. Always null if `iso_currency_code` is non-null. Unofficial currency codes are used for currencies that do not have official ISO currency codes, such as cryptocurrencies and the currencies of certain countries.<br><br>See the [currency code schema](https://plaid.com/docs/api/accounts#currency-code-schema) for a full listing of supported `unofficial_currency_code`s.|
|historical_balances|[[CraVoaReportAccountHistoricalBalance](#schemacravoareportaccounthistoricalbalance)]|true|none|Calculated data about the historical balances on the account.<br><br>Available for `credit` and `depository` type accounts.|
|average_balance_30_days|number(double) \| null|true|none|The average balance in the account over the last 30 days. Calculated using the derived historical balances.|
|average_balance_60_days|number(double) \| null|true|none|The average balance in the account over the last 60 days. Calculated using the derived historical balances.|
|nsf_overdraft_transactions_count|number|true|none|The number of net NSF fee transactions in the time range for the report in the given account (not counting any fees that were reversed within the time range).|

|iso_currency_code|string \| null|true|none|The ISO-4217 currency code of the balance. Always `null` if `unofficial_currency_code` is non-`null`.|
|unofficial_currency_code|string \| null|true|none|The unofficial currency code associated with the balance. Always `null` if `iso_currency_code` is non-`null`.<br><br>See the [currency code schema](https://plaid.com/docs/api/accounts#currency-code-schema) for a full listing of supported `unofficial_currency_code`s.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|transaction_id|string|true|none|The unique ID of the transaction. Like all Plaid identifiers, the `transaction_id` is case sensitive.|
|item_id|[ItemId](#schemaitemid)|true|none|The `item_id` of the Item associated with this webhook, warning, or error|
|account_id|string|true|none|Plaid's unique identifier for the account. This value will not change unless Plaid can't reconcile the account with the data returned by the financial institution. This may occur, for example, when the name of the account changes. If this happens a new `account_id` will be assigned to the account.<br><br>If an account with a specific `account_id` disappears instead of changing, the account is likely closed. Closed accounts are not returned by the Plaid API.<br><br>Like all Plaid identifiers, the `account_id` is case sensitive.|
|amount|number(double)|true|none|The settled value of the transaction, denominated in the transaction's currency as stated in `iso_currency_code` or `unofficial_currency_code`.<br>Positive values when money moves out of the account; negative values when money moves in.<br>For example, credit card purchases are positive; credit card payment, direct deposits, and refunds are negative.|
|date|string(date)|true|none|For pending transactions, the date that the transaction occurred; for posted transactions, the date that the transaction posted.<br>Both dates are returned in an ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).|
|original_description|string|true|none|The string returned by the financial institution to describe the transaction.|
|iso_currency_code|[CreditIsoCurrencyCode](#schemacreditisocurrencycode)|true|none|The ISO 4217 currency code of the amount or balance.|
|unofficial_currency_code|[CreditUnofficialCurrencyCode](#schemacreditunofficialcurrencycode)|true|none|The unofficial currency code associated with the amount or balance. Always `null` if `iso_currency_code` is non-null.<br>Unofficial currency codes are used for currencies that do not have official ISO currency codes, such as cryptocurrencies and the currencies of certain countries.|
|outlier|[CraVerificationIncomeTransactionOutlier](#schemacraverificationincometransactionoutlier)|true|none|Metadata on whether this income transaction is an outlier.|

When calling `/link/token/create`, this field is required when using Plaid Check (CRA) products; invalid if not using Plaid Check (CRA) products.<br><br>`ACCOUNT_REVIEW_CREDIT`: In connection with a consumer credit transaction for the review or collection of an account pursuant to FCRA Section 604(a)(3)(A).<br><br>`ACCOUNT_REVIEW_NON_CREDIT`: For a legitimate business need of the information to review a non-credit account provided primarily for personal, family, or household purposes to determine whether the consumer continues to meet the terms of the account pursuant to FCRA Section 604(a)(3)(F)(2).<br><br>`EXTENSION_OF_CREDIT`: In connection with a credit transaction initiated by and involving the consumer pursuant to FCRA Section 604(a)(3)(A).<br><br>`LEGITIMATE_BUSINESS_NEED_TENANT_SCREENING`: For a legitimate business need in connection with a business transaction initiated by the consumer primarily for personal, family, or household purposes in connection with a property rental assessment pursuant to FCRA Section 604(a)(3)(F)(i).<br><br>`LEGITIMATE_BUSINESS_NEED_OTHER`: For a legitimate business need in connection with a business transaction made primarily for personal, family, or household initiated by the consumer pursuant to FCRA Section 604(a)(3)(F)(i).<br><br>`WRITTEN_INSTRUCTION_PREQUALIFICATION`: In accordance with the written instructions of the consumer pursuant to FCRA Section 604(a)(2), to evaluate an application's profile to make an offer to the consumer.<br><br>`WRITTEN_INSTRUCTION_OTHER`: In accordance with the written instructions of the consumer pursuant to FCRA Section 604(a)(2), such as when an individual agrees to act as a guarantor or assumes personal liability for a consumer, business, or commercial loan.<br><br>`ELIGIBILITY_FOR_GOVT_BENEFITS`:  In connection with an eligibility determination for a government benefit where the entity is required to consider an applicant's financial status pursuant to FCRA Section 604(a)(3)(D).|
|client_report_id|string|true|none|Client-generated identifier, which can be used by lenders to track loan applications.|
|report_type|[CraCreditProfileReportType](#schemacracreditprofilereporttype)|true|none|The product type for the credit profile report request.|
|inquiry_type|[CraCreditProfileInquiryType](#schemacracreditprofileinquirytype)|true|none|The inquiry type of credit profile report.|

<!-- backwards compatibility -->

<a id="tocscrareportcreaterequest"></a>

```json
{
  "client_id": "string",
  "secret": "string",
  "user_id": "string",
  "products": [
    {
      "product": "cra_base_report",
      "version": "string",
      "options": {
        "require_identity": true
      }
    }
  ],
  "scope": {},
  "decision_stage": "PREQUALIFICATION",
  "consumer_report_permissible_purpose": {},
  "client_report_id": "string",
  "days_requested": 0,
  "days_required": 0,
  "include_investments": true,
  "include_identity_match": true,
  "webhook": "http://example.com"
}
```

CraReportCreateRequest defines the request schema for `/cra/report/create`.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|client_id|[APIClientID](#schemaapiclientid)|false|none|Your Plaid API `client_id`. The `client_id` is required and may be provided either in the `PLAID-CLIENT-ID` header or as part of a request body.|
|secret|[APISecret](#schemaapisecret)|false|none|Your Plaid API `secret`. The `secret` is required and may be provided either in the `PLAID-SECRET` header or as part of a request body.|
|user_id|[NewUserID](#schemanewuserid)|true|none|A unique user identifier, created by `/user/create`. Integrations that began using `/user/create` after December 10, 2025 use this field to identify a user instead of the `user_token`. For more details, see [New User APIs](https://plaid.com/docs/api/users/user-apis).|
|products|[[CraReportProduct](#schemacrareportproduct)]|true|none|The Plaid Check products, versions, and options to generate for the report.|
|scope|object|true|none|none|
|decision_stage|[CraReportDecisionStage](#schemacrareportdecisionstage)|true|none|The stage in the credit or other eligibility decisioning lifecycle for which a given report will be utilized.<br><br>Allowable permissible purposes for `PREQUALIFICATION`:<br><br>- `WRITTEN_INSTRUCTION_PREQUALIFICATION`<br><br>Allowable permissible purposes for `DECISIONING`:<br><br>- `ELIGIBILITY_FOR_GOVT_BENEFITS`<br>- `EXTENSION_OF_CREDIT`<br>- `LEGITIMATE_BUSINESS_NEED_OTHER`<br>- `LEGITIMATE_BUSINESS_NEED_TENANT_SCREENING`<br>- `WRITTEN_INSTRUCTION_OTHER`<br><br>If an incompatible `decision_stage` and `consumer_report_permissible_purpose` pairing is requested, an `INVALID_FIELD` error is returned. If your client isn't yet enabled for a given `decision_stage` on a product, a `DECISION_STAGE_NOT_ENABLED` error is returned instead (contact your Plaid account manager to enable it).|
|consumer_report_permissible_purpose|object|true|none|none|
|client_report_id|string \| null|false|none|Client-generated identifier, which can be used by lenders to track loan applications.|
|days_requested|integer \| null|false|none|The number of days of history to include in Plaid Check products. Maximum is 731. If a value lower than 180 is provided, a minimum of 180 days of history will be requested.|
|days_required|integer \| null|false|none|The minimum number of days of data required for the report to be successfully generated.|
|include_investments|boolean \| null|false|none|Indicates that investment data should be extracted from the linked account(s).|
|include_identity_match|boolean \| null|false|none|Indicates that identity match results should be included for all products in the report that contain identity information. Defaults to `false`.|
|webhook|string(url)|false|none|The destination URL to which the report's webhooks will be sent.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|decision_stage|PREQUALIFICATION|
|decision_stage|DECISIONING|
|decision_stage|SERVICING|

<a id="tocscrareporterrorcode"></a>

```json
"DATA_UNAVAILABLE"
```

The reason every product in a Consumer Report failed to generate. `null` when at least one product succeeded.

`DATA_UNAVAILABLE`: Plaid could not retrieve enough data from the user's Items to generate any of the requested products. Sending the user through Link to add or repair Items may resolve this.

`INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR`: Plaid encountered an unexpected error while generating the report.

<h2 id="tocS_CraReportDecisionStage">CraReportDecisionStage</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacrareportdecisionstage"></a>
<a id="schema_CraReportDecisionStage"></a>
<a id="tocScrareportdecisionstage"></a>
<a id="tocscrareportdecisionstage"></a>

```json
"PREQUALIFICATION"
```

The stage in the credit or other eligibility decisioning lifecycle for which a given report will be utilized.

Allowable permissible purposes for `PREQUALIFICATION`:

- `WRITTEN_INSTRUCTION_PREQUALIFICATION`

Allowable permissible purposes for `DECISIONING`:

- `ELIGIBILITY_FOR_GOVT_BENEFITS`
- `EXTENSION_OF_CREDIT`
- `LEGITIMATE_BUSINESS_NEED_OTHER`
- `LEGITIMATE_BUSINESS_NEED_TENANT_SCREENING`
- `WRITTEN_INSTRUCTION_OTHER`

If an incompatible `decision_stage` and `consumer_report_permissible_purpose` pairing is requested, an `INVALID_FIELD` error is returned. If your client isn't yet enabled for a given `decision_stage` on a product, a `DECISION_STAGE_NOT_ENABLED` error is returned instead (contact your Plaid account manager to enable it).

Base Report metadata returned by `/cra/report/get`.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|generated_time|string(date-time) \| null|true|none|The time the report was generated. May be `null` if unavailable.|
|item_count|integer|true|none|The number of Items used to generate the report.|
|account_count|integer|true|none|The number of accounts used to generate the report.|
|institution_ids|[string]|true|none|The institution IDs of the Items used to generate the report.|
|days_requested|integer|true|none|The number of days of transaction history requested.|
|primary_account_count|integer|true|none|The number of accounts carrying Plaid's primary account indicator.|
|depository_account_type_count|integer|true|none|The number of depository accounts used to generate the report.|
|credit_account_type_count|integer|true|none|The number of credit accounts used to generate the report.|
|investment_account_type_count|integer|true|none|The number of investment accounts used to generate the report.|
|other_account_type_count|integer|true|none|The number of accounts that are neither depository, credit, nor investment.|
|multiple_owner_account_count|integer|true|none|The number of accounts with multiple owners.|
|oldest_transaction_date|string(date) \| null|true|none|The earliest transaction date across the accounts the report was generated from. `null` if none of those accounts have posted transactions.|
|most_recent_transaction_date|string(date) \| null|true|none|The latest transaction date across the accounts the report was generated from. `null` if none of those accounts have posted transactions.|

An account included in a Base Report returned by `/cra/report/get`.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|string|true|none|Plaid's unique identifier for the account. This value will not change unless Plaid can't reconcile the account with the data returned by the financial institution. This may occur, for example, when the name of the account changes. If this happens a new `account_id` will be assigned to the account.<br><br>Like all Plaid identifiers, the `account_id` is case sensitive.|
|name|string|true|none|The name of the account, either assigned by the user or by the financial institution itself.|
|official_name|string \| null|true|none|The official name of the account as given by the financial institution.|
|mask|string \| null|true|none|The last 2-4 alphanumeric characters of an account's official account number. Note that the mask may be non-unique between an Item's accounts, and it may also not match the mask that the bank displays to the user.|
|type|[AccountType](#schemaaccounttype)|true|none|`investment:` Investment account. In API versions 2018-05-22 and earlier, this type is called `brokerage` instead.<br><br>`credit:` Credit card<br><br>`depository:` Depository account<br><br>`loan:` Loan account<br><br>`other:` Non-specified account type<br><br>See the [Account type schema](https://plaid.com/docs/api/accounts#account-type-schema) for a full listing of account types and corresponding subtypes.|
|subtype|[AccountSubtype](#schemaaccountsubtype)|true|none|See the [Account type schema](https://plaid.com/docs/api/accounts/#account-type-schema) for a full listing of account types and corresponding subtypes.|
|days_available|integer|true|none|The number of days of transaction history available for the account, typically the time since the date of its earliest transaction.|
|metadata|[BaseReportAccountMetadata](#schemabasereportaccountmetadata)|true|none|Metadata about the extracted account.|
|balances|[CraReportGetBaseReportAccountBalances](#schemacrareportgetbasereportaccountbalances)|true|none|The balances of an account in a Base Report.|
|owners|[[Owner](#schemaowner)]|true|none|Data returned by the financial institution about the account owner or owners. Multiple owners on a single account are represented in the same `owner` object, not in multiple owner objects within the array. Empty if no owners are found.|
|ownership_type|[OwnershipType](#schemaownershiptype)|true|none|How an asset is owned.<br><br>`association`: Ownership by a corporation, partnership, or unincorporated association, including for-profit and not-for-profit organizations.<br><br>`individual`: Ownership by an individual.<br><br>`joint`: Joint ownership by multiple parties.<br><br>`trust`: Ownership by a revocable or irrevocable trust.|
|consumer_disputes|[[ConsumerDispute](#schemaconsumerdispute)]|true|none|The valid dispute statements previously submitted by the consumer for this account.|
|transactions|[[CraReportGetBaseReportTransaction](#schemacrareportgetbasereporttransaction)]|true|none|The transaction history of the account. Some transactions may have their details masked in accordance with the FCRA; these have a `credit_category` of `MASKED_TRANSACTION_CATEGORY`.|
|historical_balances|[[BaseReportHistoricalBalance](#schemabasereporthistoricalbalance)]|false|none|The calculated daily historical balances of the account. Omitted for `investment` accounts or when historical balances could not be computed.|
|account_insights|object|false|none|none|
|attributes|[CraReportGetBaseReportAccountAttributes](#schemacrareportgetbasereportaccountattributes)|true|none|Attributes derived from the account's transaction-level data. May be `null` if attributes were not available.|
|identity_match|[CraReportGetBaseReportAccountIdentityMatch](#schemacrareportgetbasereportaccountidentitymatch)|false|none|Scores for how closely the user's identity, as provided via `/user/create` or `/user/update`, matches the account owner information reported by the financial institution. Only present if the report was created with `include_identity_match` set to `true`, and omitted for accounts that were not scored. Within each score object, `score` is `null` when either the user or the financial institution did not provide that field.|

```json
{

  "most_recent_thirty_day_average_balance": 0,

    {
      "start_date": "1970-01-01",

        "amount": 0,
        "iso_currency_code": "string",

      }
    }
  ]

```

The balances of an account in a Base Report.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|available|number(double) \| null|true|none|The amount of funds available to be withdrawn from the account, as determined by the financial institution.<br><br>For `credit`-type accounts, the `available` balance typically equals the `limit` less the `current` balance, less any pending outflows plus any pending inflows.<br><br>For `depository`-type accounts, the `available` balance typically equals the `current` balance less any pending outflows plus any pending inflows, and does not include the overdraft limit.<br><br>For `investment`-type accounts, the `available` balance is the total cash available to withdraw as presented by the institution.<br><br>`null` if the institution does not provide an `available` balance. If `current` is `null`, this field is guaranteed not to be `null`.|
|current|number(double) \| null|true|none|The total amount of funds in or owed by the account.<br><br>For `credit`-type accounts, a positive balance indicates the amount owed; a negative amount indicates the lender owing the account holder.<br><br>For `loan`-type accounts, the current balance is the principal remaining on the loan.<br><br>For `investment`-type accounts, the current balance is the total value of assets as presented by the institution.<br><br>If `available` is `null`, this field is guaranteed not to be `null`.|
|limit|number(double) \| null|true|none|For `credit`-type accounts, the credit limit.<br><br>For `depository`-type accounts, the pre-arranged overdraft limit.<br><br>This field is typically only available for `credit`-type accounts.|
|iso_currency_code|[CreditIsoCurrencyCode](#schemacreditisocurrencycode)|true|none|The ISO 4217 currency code of the amount or balance.|
|unofficial_currency_code|[CreditUnofficialCurrencyCode](#schemacreditunofficialcurrencycode)|true|none|The unofficial currency code associated with the amount or balance. Always `null` if `iso_currency_code` is non-null.<br>Unofficial currency codes are used for currencies that do not have official ISO currency codes, such as cryptocurrencies and the currencies of certain countries.|
|average_balance|number(double) \| null|true|none|The average historical balance over the time range of the report. `null` if it could not be computed.|
|most_recent_thirty_day_average_balance|number(double) \| null|true|none|The average historical balance over the most recent 30 days. `null` if it could not be computed.|
|average_monthly_balances|[[CraReportGetBaseReportAverageMonthlyBalance](#schemacrareportgetbasereportaveragemonthlybalance)]|true|none|The average historical balance for each calendar month. Empty if it could not be computed.|

Scores for how closely the user's identity, as provided via `/user/create` or `/user/update`, matches the account owner information reported by the financial institution. Only present if the report was created with `include_identity_match` set to `true`, and omitted for accounts that were not scored. Within each score object, `score` is `null` when either the user or the financial institution did not provide that field.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|legal_name|[NameMatchScore](#schemanamematchscore)|true|none|Score found by matching name provided by the API with the name on the account at the financial institution. If the account contains multiple owners, the maximum match score is filled.|
|phone_number|[PhoneNumberMatchScore](#schemaphonenumbermatchscore)|true|none|Score found by matching phone number provided by the API with the phone number on the account at the financial institution. 100 is a perfect match and 0 is a no match. If the account contains multiple owners, the maximum match score is filled.|
|email_address|[EmailAddressMatchScore](#schemaemailaddressmatchscore)|true|none|Score found by matching email provided by the API with the email on the account at the financial institution. 100 is a perfect match and 0 is a no match. If the account contains multiple owners, the maximum match score is filled.|
|address|[AddressMatchScore](#schemaaddressmatchscore)|true|none|Score found by matching address provided by the API with the address on the account at the financial institution. The score can range from 0 to 100 where 100 is a perfect match and 0 is a no match. If the account contains multiple owners, the maximum match score is filled.|

A transaction in a Base Report returned by `/cra/report/get`.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|transaction_id|string|true|none|The unique ID of the transaction. Like all Plaid identifiers, the `transaction_id` is case sensitive.|
|account_id|string|true|none|The ID of the account in which this transaction occurred.|
|amount|number(double)|true|none|The settled value of the transaction, denominated in the transaction's currency, as stated in `iso_currency_code` or `unofficial_currency_code`. Positive values when money moves out of the account; negative values when money moves in. For example, debit card purchases are positive; credit card payments, direct deposits, and refunds are negative.|
|iso_currency_code|[CreditIsoCurrencyCode](#schemacreditisocurrencycode)|true|none|The ISO 4217 currency code of the amount or balance.|
|unofficial_currency_code|[CreditUnofficialCurrencyCode](#schemacreditunofficialcurrencycode)|true|none|The unofficial currency code associated with the amount or balance. Always `null` if `iso_currency_code` is non-null.<br>Unofficial currency codes are used for currencies that do not have official ISO currency codes, such as cryptocurrencies and the currencies of certain countries.|
|original_description|string \| null|true|none|The string returned by the financial institution to describe the transaction.|
|merchant_name|string \| null|true|none|The merchant name, as enriched by Plaid. `null` for transactions with no meaningful merchant, such as checks or account transfers.|
|credit_category|[CreditCategory](#schemacreditcategory)|true|none|Information describing the intent of the transaction. Most relevant for credit use cases, but not limited to such use cases.<br><br>See the [`taxonomy csv file`](https://plaid.com/documents/credit-category-taxonomy.csv) for a full list of credit categories.|
|check_number|string \| null|true|none|The check number of the transaction. Only populated for check transactions.|
|date|string(date)|true|none|For pending transactions, the date that the transaction occurred; for posted transactions, the date that the transaction posted. Returned in [ISO 8601](https://wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format (YYYY-MM-DD).|
|date_transacted|string(date) \| null|true|none|The date on which the transaction took place, in [ISO 8601](https://wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format (YYYY-MM-DD). `null` if the financial institution did not provide it.|
|pending|boolean|true|none|When `true`, identifies the transaction as pending or unsettled. Pending transaction details (`amount`, `merchant_name`, `credit_category`) may change before they are settled.|
|account_owner|string \| null|true|none|The name of the account owner. This field is not typically populated and only relevant when dealing with sub-accounts.|
|location|[Location](#schemalocation)|true|none|A representation of where a transaction took place. Location data is provided only for transactions at physical locations, not for online transactions. Location data availability depends primarily on the merchant and is most likely to be populated for transactions at large retail chains; small, local businesses are less likely to have location data available.|
|name|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** The merchant name or transaction description.<br><br>Note: This is a legacy field that is not actively maintained. Use `merchant_name` instead for the merchant name.|
|category|[string]|false|none|A hierarchical array of the categories to which this transaction belongs. For a full list of categories, see [`/categories/get`](https://plaid.com/docs/api/products/transactions/#categoriesget).|
|category_id|string \| null|false|none|The ID of the category to which this transaction belongs. For a full list of categories, see [`/categories/get`](https://plaid.com/docs/api/products/transactions/#categoriesget).|
|personal_finance_category|object|false|none|none|

|is_primary|boolean|true|none|Whether the account is predicted to be a primary account. Only one account per account type across the user's Items will have a value of `true`.|

<h2 id="tocS_CraReportGetAccountIdentityMatch">CraReportGetAccountIdentityMatch</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacrareportgetaccountidentitymatch"></a>
<a id="schema_CraReportGetAccountIdentityMatch"></a>

<a id="tocscrareportgetaccountidentitymatch"></a>

```json
{
  "legal_name": {
    "score": 0,
    "is_first_name_or_last_name_match": true,
    "is_nickname_match": true,
    "is_business_name_detected": true
  },
  "phone_number": {
    "score": 0
  },
  "email_address": {
    "score": 0
  },
  "address": {
    "score": 0,
    "is_postal_code_match": true
  }
}
```

Scores for how closely the user's identity, as provided via `/user/create` or `/user/update`, matches the account owner information reported by the financial institution. `null` if the account was not scored or if identity matching is not supported by the product. Within each score object, `score` is `null` when either the user or the financial institution did not provide that field.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|legal_name|[NameMatchScore](#schemanamematchscore)|true|none|Score found by matching name provided by the API with the name on the account at the financial institution. If the account contains multiple owners, the maximum match score is filled.|
|phone_number|[PhoneNumberMatchScore](#schemaphonenumbermatchscore)|true|none|Score found by matching phone number provided by the API with the phone number on the account at the financial institution. 100 is a perfect match and 0 is a no match. If the account contains multiple owners, the maximum match score is filled.|
|email_address|[EmailAddressMatchScore](#schemaemailaddressmatchscore)|true|none|Score found by matching email provided by the API with the email on the account at the financial institution. 100 is a perfect match and 0 is a no match. If the account contains multiple owners, the maximum match score is filled.|
|address|[AddressMatchScore](#schemaaddressmatchscore)|true|none|Score found by matching address provided by the API with the address on the account at the financial institution. The score can range from 0 to 100 where 100 is a perfect match and 0 is a no match. If the account contains multiple owners, the maximum match score is filled.|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|report|[CraReportGetReport](#schemacrareportgetreport)|true|none|The Consumer Report returned by `/cra/report/get`.|

Integrations that began using `/user/create` after December 10, 2025 use this field to identify a user instead of the `user_token`. |client_user_id|string \| null|true|none|The unique ID representing the end user that you supplied as `client_user_id` when creating the user via `/user/create`. `null` if the user has no `client_user_id` on record.|
|warnings|[[CheckReportWarning](#schemacheckreportwarning)]|true|none|User or report-level errors that affected the overall report but do not map to a specific product failure.|

Details about an asset.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|AssetUniqueIdentifier|string|true|none|A vendor created unique Identifier.|
|AssetAccountIdentifier|string|true|none|A unique alphanumeric string identifying an asset.|
|AssetAsOfDate|string|true|none|Account Report As of Date / Create Date. Format YYYY-MM-DD|
|AssetDescription|string \| null|true|none|A text description that further defines the Asset. This could be used to describe the shares associated with the stocks, bonds or mutual funds, retirement funds or business owned that the borrower has disclosed (named) as an asset.|
|AssetAvailableBalanceAmount|number(double)|true|none|Asset Account Available Balance.|
|AssetCurrentBalanceAmount|number(double)|true|none|Asset Account Current Balance.|
|AssetHoldingBalanceAmount|number(double) \| null|false|none|Total market value of holdings (non-restricted, vested, not crypto, not other, not cash) Note: Any employer stock plan balance must be excluded from the total account balance (identification is 'stock plan')|
|AssetHoldingBalanceNetMarginAmount|number(double) \| null|false|none|HoldingsBalance net MarginAmount|
|AssetBondsBalanceAmount|number(double) \| null|false|none|Total market value of all bonds held (non-restricted, vested)|
|AssetStocksBalanceAmount|number(double) \| null|false|none|Total market value of all stocks held (non-restricted, vested, not employer sponsored stock plan)|
|AssetCryptoBalanceAmount|number(double) \| null|false|none|Total balance of all cryptocurrency held (non-restricted, vested)|
|AssetOtherBalanceAmount|number(double) \| null|false|none|Total balance of all other holding types (non-restricted, vested)|

|AssetType|[AssetType](#schemaassettype)|true|none|A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies financial assets in a mortgage loan transaction. Assets may be either liquid or fixed and are associated with a corresponding asset amount.|

|AssetOwnershipType|string \| null|true|none|Ownership type of the asset account.|
|AssetRetirementIndicator|string \| null|false|none|Whether or not the account is a retirement account (e.g., 401K, 403b, 457, thrift savings plans, traditional and Roth, IRAs, SEP-IRA, SIMPLE-IRA, KEOGH, state retirement savings plans, other independent and IRS-qualified employer retirement plans)|

Identity information about an account

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|string|true|none|Plaid's unique identifier for the account. This value will not change unless Plaid can't reconcile the account with the data returned by the financial institution. This may occur, for example, when the name of the account changes. If this happens a new `account_id` will be assigned to the account.<br><br>The `account_id` can also change if the `access_token` is deleted and the same credentials that were used to generate that `access_token` are used to generate a new `access_token` on a later date. In that case, the new `account_id` will be different from the old `account_id`.<br><br>If an account with a specific `account_id` disappears instead of changing, the account is likely closed. Closed accounts are not returned by the Plaid API.<br><br>When using a CRA endpoint (an endpoint associated with Plaid Check Consumer Report, i.e. any endpoint beginning with `/cra/`), the `account_id` returned will not match the `account_id` returned by a non-CRA endpoint.<br><br>Like all Plaid identifiers, the `account_id` is case sensitive.|
|balances|[AccountBalance](#schemaaccountbalance)|true|none|A set of fields describing the balance for an account. For real-time values, use `/accounts/balance/get` or `/signal/evaluate` (with a Balance-only ruleset), which are fetched live from the institution at request time. Values returned by other endpoints may be cached, or adjusted by Plaid to reflect transaction activity received since the last refresh.|
|mask|string \| null|true|none|The last 2-4 alphanumeric characters of either the account's displayed mask or the account's official account number. Note that the mask may be non-unique between an Item's accounts.|
|name|string|true|none|The name of the account, either assigned by the user or by the financial institution itself|
|official_name|string \| null|true|none|The official name of the account as given by the financial institution|
|type|[AccountType](#schemaaccounttype)|true|none|`investment:` Investment account. In API versions 2018-05-22 and earlier, this type is called `brokerage` instead.<br><br>`credit:` Credit card<br><br>`depository:` Depository account<br><br>`loan:` Loan account<br><br>`other:` Non-specified account type<br><br>See the [Account type schema](https://plaid.com/docs/api/accounts#account-type-schema) for a full listing of account types and corresponding subtypes.|
|subtype|[AccountSubtype](#schemaaccountsubtype)|true|none|See the [Account type schema](https://plaid.com/docs/api/accounts/#account-type-schema) for a full listing of account types and corresponding subtypes.|
|verification_status|string|false|none|Indicates an Item's micro-deposit-based verification or database verification status. This field is only populated when using Auth and falling back to micro-deposit or database verification. Possible values are:<br><br>`pending_automatic_verification`: The Item is pending automatic verification.<br><br>`pending_manual_verification`: The Item is pending manual micro-deposit verification. Items remain in this state until the user successfully verifies the code.<br><br>`automatically_verified`: The Item has successfully been automatically verified.<br><br>`manually_verified`: The Item has successfully been manually verified.<br><br>`verification_expired`: Plaid was unable to automatically verify the deposit within 7 calendar days and will no longer attempt to validate the Item. Users may retry by submitting their information again through Link.<br><br>`verification_failed`: The Item failed manual micro-deposit verification because the user exhausted all 3 verification attempts. Users may retry by submitting their information again through Link.<br><br>`unsent`: The Item is pending micro-deposit verification, but Plaid has not yet sent the micro-deposit.<br><br>`database_insights_fail`: The Item's numbers have been verified using Plaid's data sources and have signal for being invalid and/or have no signal for being valid. Typically this indicates that the routing number is invalid, the account number does not match the account number format associated with the routing number, or the account has been reported as closed or frozen. Only returned for Auth Items created via Database Auth.<br><br>`database_insights_pass`: The Item's numbers have been verified using Plaid's data sources: the routing and account number match a routing and account number of an account recognized on the Plaid network, and the account is not known by Plaid to be frozen or closed. Only returned for Auth Items created via Database Auth.<br><br>`database_insights_pass_with_caution`: The Item's numbers have been verified using Plaid's data sources and have some signal for being valid: the routing and account number were not recognized on the Plaid network, but the routing number is valid and the account number is a potential valid account number for that routing number. Only returned for Auth Items created via Database Auth.<br><br>`database_matched`: (deprecated) The Item has successfully been verified using Plaid's data sources. Only returned for Auth Items created via Database Match.<br><br>Omitted or empty string: Neither micro-deposit-based verification nor database verification are being used for the Item.|
|verification_name|string|false|none|The account holder name that was used for micro-deposit and/or database verification. Only returned for Auth Items created via micro-deposit or database verification. This name was manually-entered by the user during Link, unless it was otherwise provided via the `user.legal_name` request field in `/link/token/create` for the Link session that created the Item.|
|verification_insights|[AccountVerificationInsights](#schemaaccountverificationinsights)|false|none|Insights from performing database verification for the account. Only returned for Auth Items using Database Auth.|
|persistent_account_id|string|false|none|A unique and persistent identifier for accounts that can be used to trace multiple instances of the same account across different Items for depository accounts. This field is currently supported only for Items at institutions that use Tokenized Account Numbers (i.e., Chase, PNC, and US Bank). Because these accounts have a different account number each time they are linked, this field may be used instead of the account number to uniquely identify an account across multiple Items for payments use cases, helping to reduce duplicate Items or attempted fraud. In Sandbox, this field is populated for TAN-based institutions (`ins_56`, `ins_13`, `ins_127990`) as well as the OAuth Sandbox institution (`ins_127287`); in Production, it will only be populated for accounts at applicable institutions.|
|apy|number(double) \| null|false|none|The annual percentage yield (APY) on an interest-bearing deposit account, expressed as a percentage (e.g. `4.25` means 4.25%). In the event that the APY is not provided by the financial institution, Plaid will return a value of `null`.|
|holder_category|[AccountHolderCategory](#schemaaccountholdercategory)|false|none|Indicates the account's categorization as either a personal or a business account. This field is currently in beta; to request access, contact your account manager. Coverage varies by institution, with approximately 70% of accounts populated overall.|
|paired_account_id|string \| null|false|none|The `account_id` of the account on the paired Item (see `paired_item_id`) that represents the same bank account as this one. For an account on a Plaid Inc Item, this is the matching account on its paired Plaid Check Item, and the reverse for an account on a Plaid Check Item. Only returned for accounts on an Item that has a paired Item. `null` means the Item has a paired Item but Plaid could not confidently match this account to an account on it. Like `account_id`, this value can change if Plaid re-creates the paired account.|
|owners|[[Owner](#schemaowner)]|true|none|Data returned by the financial institution about the account owner or owners. Only returned by Identity or Assets endpoints. For business accounts, the name reported may be either the name of the individual or the name of the business, depending on the institution. To determine whether the linked account is a business account, use the `holder_category` field on the account object. Multiple owners on a single account will be represented in the same `owner` object, not in multiple owner objects within the array. In API versions 2018-05-22 and earlier, the `owners` object is not returned, and instead identity information is returned in the top level `identity` object. For more details, see [Plaid API versioning](https://plaid.com/docs/api/versioning/#version-2019-05-29)|
|documents|[[IdentityDocumentUpload](#schemaidentitydocumentupload)]|false|none|Data about the documents that were uploaded as proof of account ownership.|

Metadata pertaining to the document.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|document_type|string \| null|false|none|The submitted document type. Currently, this will always be `BANK_STATEMENT`.|
|is_account_number_match|boolean \| null|false|none|Boolean field indicating whether the uploaded document's account number matches the account number we have on file. If `false`, it is not recommended to accept the uploaded identity data as accurate without further verification.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|client_id|[APIClientID](#schemaapiclientid)|false|none|Your Plaid API `client_id`. The `client_id` is required and may be provided either in the `PLAID-CLIENT-ID` header or as part of a request body.|

|reason_note|string \| null|false|none|Additional context or details about the reason for removing the Item. Personally identifiable information, such as an email address or phone number, should not be included in the `reason_note`.|

<h2 id="tocS_ItemRemoveReasonCode">ItemRemoveReasonCode</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaitemremovereasoncode"></a>
<a id="schema_ItemRemoveReasonCode"></a>
<a id="tocSitemremovereasoncode"></a>
<a id="tocsitemremovereasoncode"></a>

```json
"FRAUD_FIRST_PARTY"
```

The reason for removing the Item

`FRAUD_FIRST_PARTY`: The end user who owns the connected bank account committed fraud

`FRAUD_FALSE_IDENTITY`: The end user created the connection using false identity information or stolen credentials

`FRAUD_ABUSE`: The end user is abusing the client's service or platform through their connected account

`FRAUD_OTHER`: Other fraud-related reasons involving the end user not covered by the specific fraud categories

`CONNECTION_IS_NON_FUNCTIONAL`: The connection to the end user's financial institution is broken and cannot be restored

`OTHER`: Any other reason for removing the connection not covered by the above categories

<h2 id="tocS_ItemImportRequestInstitutionID">ItemImportRequestInstitutionID</h2>

The Plaid Institution ID associated with the Item. Most callers omit this field; Plaid resolves your institution automatically. If your organization has multiple institutions, contact Plaid to determine whether you should send it.

<h2 id="tocS_ItemAuthMethod">ItemAuthMethod</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaitemauthmethod"></a>
<a id="schema_ItemAuthMethod"></a>
<a id="tocSitemauthmethod"></a>
<a id="tocsitemauthmethod"></a>

```json
"INSTANT_AUTH"
```

The method used to populate Auth data for the Item. This field is only populated for Items that have had Auth numbers data set on at least one of their accounts, and will be omitted otherwise. For info about the various flows, see our [Auth coverage documentation](https://plaid.com/docs/auth/coverage/).

`INSTANT_AUTH`: The Item's Auth data was provided directly by the user's institution connection.

`INSTANT_MATCH`: The Item's Auth data was provided via the Instant Match fallback flow.

`AUTOMATED_MICRODEPOSITS`: The Item's Auth data was provided via the Automated Micro-deposits flow.

`SAME_DAY_MICRODEPOSITS`: The Item's Auth data was provided via the Same-Day Micro-deposits flow.

`INSTANT_MICRODEPOSITS`: The Item's Auth data was provided via the Instant Micro-deposits flow.

`DATABASE_MATCH`: The Item's Auth data was provided via the Database Match flow.

`DATABASE_INSIGHTS`: The Item's Auth data was provided via the Database Insights flow.

`TRANSFER_MIGRATED`: The Item's Auth data was provided via [`/transfer/migrate_account`](https://plaid.com/docs/api/products/transfer/account-linking/#migrate-account-into-transfers).

`INVESTMENTS_FALLBACK`: The Item's Auth data for Investments Move was provided via a [fallback flow](https://plaid.com/docs/investments-move/#fallback-flows).

### Properties
